instruction.instruction_text: From the starting position, proceed laterally to the extremity of the table, situated at its most distal point. Proceed in a generally easterly direction towards the entranceway located to your right. Upon reaching the entranceway, enter the kitchen area, where the cooking apparatus (stove) will be positioned to your right. Continue moving in a straight line until the refrigeration unit comes into view on your left side. Progress further in the same direction until you encounter a diminutive sink situated on your left and shelving units positioned on your right.
Turn right at the prominent timepiece, proceed directly through the kitchen area, upon encountering the temperature control device affixed to the wall, you will be situated adjacent to the lavatory.

Proceed down the center of the kitchen, traversing the space between the two countertops. Enter the adjacent compact chamber located off the kitchen. Egress from this compartment and execute a 90-degree turn to the right. Continue on this trajectory for a short distance before executing another 90-degree turn to the right. Proceed to the designated area known as the bedroom.

Exit the restroom and proceed eastward, then make a counterclockwise rotation of ninety degrees at the prominent timepiece located on the wall, subsequently enter the sleeping quarters and assume a position adjacent to the bed.
Ascend the staircase by proceeding upwards for approximately 10 steps. Proceed northwards along the stairwell for a distance of 2-3 steps until you reach a landing adjacent to an open doorway.

Enter the dining room and proceed to the opposite extremity of the space. Traverse the double doors situated on your right-hand side. Continue onward in a northerly direction along the walkway, culminating at the point where you will pause outside on the mat.

Proceed straight ahead for a distance of approximately 0 meters, then execute a 90-degree turn to the left, continuing on the new course until you reach the terminus of the hallway, whereupon halt immediately adjacent to the entrance preceding the bedroom.

Proceed along the hallway in a northerly direction until you reach the telephone located on your right-hand side. Upon reaching the telephone, execute a 90-degree counterclockwise rotation to orient yourself towards the east. Continue walking in a generally southeasterly direction for approximately 10 feet until you arrive at the intersection.
Proceed along the corridor, turning immediately to your right. Position yourself within the narrow passageway situated between the adjacent doorways.

Proceed northbound, traversing past an exterior-facing zone situated on your right-hand side, and continue onward until you reach a dining area. From there, proceed straight ahead, passing directly adjacent to a dining table. Continue walking for approximately 3 sets of doors, halting momentarily just prior to arriving at their location.

Proceed from the bedroom, maintaining a direct course down the hallway for its entirety. Upon reaching the end of the hallway, execute a 90-degree turn to the left, transitioning onto the adjacent corridor. Continue along this corridor until you reach the intersection with the hallway featuring a prominent gray wall. At this juncture, execute a 90-degree turn to the right, entering the hallway with the aforementioned characteristic wall. Upon entering, proceed directly to the edge of the table situated nearest your current position.

Proceed through the arched entranceway leading into the chamber featuring a mosaic flooring surface. Proceed through the arched entranceway situated adjacent to the staircase. Continue along the tiled corridor via the doorway located directly ahead, entering the bedroom characterized by a red bedspread.

Proceed north from your current location, traversing a distance of approximately 10 feet, to reach the kitchen area. From there, continue east for another 12 feet until you arrive behind the couch. Rotate your direction by 90 degrees clockwise and proceed south for a distance of 15 feet to enter the fitness room. Upon entering, position yourself adjacent to the treadmill.
Proceed by walking through the breakfast nook, then continue onward past the kitchen area. Next, pass by the thermostat unit. Upon reaching the exercise ball, come to a stop.
Proceed through the entrance, make a left turn into the second opening, halt immediately prior to the vegetation arrangement situated on your right.

Proceed from the current location, maintaining the fireplace as a stationary point on your left-hand side. Traverse the floor surface until you arrive at the entrance to the adjacent corridor, then halt when you reach the door assembly.

Proceed by walking past the white couch situated on your left-hand side. Continue onward through the entryway and subsequently pass the oval-shaped table located within it. Bring your movement to a halt directly adjacent to the rectangular table.

Proceed through the entrance into the room, orienting yourself with the bathtub as your primary reference point. Rotate 90 degrees counterclockwise to align yourself with the bar, positioning yourself immediately prior to it. From this location, pivot 90 degrees to the left, then ascend the staircase. Upon reaching the top, proceed to the first door situated on your right-hand side. Continue walking until you arrive directly anterior to the table.

From your current location, proceed laterally to the east until you reach the termination point of the hallway. Upon reaching the terminus, turn clockwise by ninety degrees to align yourself with the entrance to the room located at the eastern extremity of the hallway. Once aligned, traverse the distance required to enter the room.

Proceed from your current location in the dining room, exit through the doorway, and enter the adjacent living room. Upon entering the living room, turn immediately to your right, proceeding towards the recreation room. Continue straight until you reach the entrance to the recreation room. Halt your progression at a point situated between the door and the pool table.

Proceed straight ahead, keeping the handrail adjacent to your right side. Upon entering the bedroom, turn ninety degrees clockwise and access the bathroom by turning into it. Position yourself beside the lavatory within the bathroom.
Proceed north for approximately 0 meters until you reach a visual reference point consisting of a photograph mounted on a vertical surface.

From the fitness room, proceed northward and turn counterclockwise by 90 degrees. Continue moving forward for approximately 10 feet until reaching the kitchen area. Proceed straight ahead through the kitchen, maintaining a northerly course, until arriving at the southernmost point where the kitchen intersects with the adjacent space. Upon exiting the kitchen, transition onto the tile flooring.

Proceed eastward along the corridor for approximately 10 feet until you reach the entrance of the room on your right. Continue onward into the room, moving directly toward the central hearth. Position yourself adjacent to the hearth.

From the art room, proceed southward, turning left by 90 degrees. Continue onward for approximately 10 feet until you reach the staircase. Turn eastward, then immediately turn northward, proceeding into the kitchen area. Upon entering the kitchen, position yourself so that the wine refrigerator is situated on your left.
Proceed directly into the dining area. Traverse the floor until you reach the entrance located on the right-hand side of the forward-facing wall. Halt momentarily within the threshold.

Turn left and depart from the closet. Proceed north for a distance of approximately zero meters until you reach the entrance to the bedroom. Turn left and enter the bedroom. Continue straight for a distance of approximately zero meters until you reach the entrance to the bathroom. Turn left and enter the bathroom.

Proceed south along the corridor for approximately 10 feet until you reach the first intersection. Turn left and continue east for another 15 feet. The next point of interest will be directly ahead, situated beneath a suspended luminescent fixture.

Proceed 0 meters past the desk, then exit through the black door situated at the rear of the room, entering the adjacent hallway. Rotate 90 degrees clockwise, positioning yourself alongside the corridor where you will encounter woven baskets and a potted plant positioned against the wall. Continue along the hallway, circumventing the point where the corridor intersects with the stairs located adjacent to the entrance of the residence, ascending the initial flight of stairs.

Proceed straight ahead into the dining room and proceed in a northeasterly direction toward the table situated on the eastern wall, adjacent to which is a table draped with a red tablecloth. Continue onward past the aforementioned table and enter the hallway. Halt beside the initial cordoned-off area located on your right.

Proceed by rotating your body 180 degrees to exit the room. Traverse the hallway, proceeding straight for approximately 10 feet until you reach the staircase. Descend the flight of stairs, comprising 12 steps, to arrive at the lower level of the residence. Upon reaching the landing, proceed forward, traversing the floor for approximately 15 feet until you encounter a platform featuring a rug as its flooring material. Continue descending the subsequent flight of stairs, consisting of 8 steps, to reach the lowest level.

Turn 90 degrees counterclockwise and proceed northwards for approximately 2 meters, circumventing a piece of furniture identified as a couch and a lower seating support known as a footstool. Continue onward and arrive at a corridor designated as the hallway, then execute a 90-degree clockwise rotation. Proceed southwards along the hallway for a distance of approximately 8 meters until reaching a cooking station referred to as the galley kitchen. From there, continue straight ahead and pass by a food preparation area, ultimately arriving at a dining zone comprising a table and chairs. Upon approaching the table, come to a complete stop and remain stationary.

Proceed along the corridor, traversing a distance of approximately two beds and passing adjacent to the entrance of the bathroom suite. Continue straight ahead into the open passageway, then arrive at a designated stopping point near the wooden cabinet.
Ascend the staircase, culminating your ascent at the uppermost landing proximal to the reflective glass surface.

Proceed forth along the linear path for a distance of approximately 0 meters, then execute a 90-degree clockwise rotation and continue moving in a southerly direction along the longitudinal axis of the hallway until arriving proximal to a prominent visual landmark featuring a depiction of a male figure.

Proceed north from your current location, circumventing the kitchen appliance situated on the western wall by approximately 90 degrees. Continue eastward for a distance of roughly 8 feet until you reach the electronic display unit positioned against the northern wall. From there, pivot 180 degrees counterclockwise and proceed southward through the transparent door located on the eastern exterior façade.

Proceed by walking forward, traversing past the window and adjacent curtain, ultimately exiting the room. Continue walking in a straight line, navigating around each picture frame situated along the wall, and come to a halt at the midpoint where there are no walls flanking you.

Exit the room and proceed to the left, where you will find a doorway located on your immediate left. Traverse through this doorway and arrive at its opposite side. Upon reaching the entrance, pause momentarily.

Exit the bathroom and proceed into the adjacent closet. Turn left approximately 90 degrees prior to reaching the bed. Continue onward until you exit the bedroom. Upon exiting, turn right by 90 degrees. Proceed through the doorway located on your right-hand side within the bedroom. Remain stationary in the threshold of the doorway.

Ascend the staircase located within the outdoor living area, proceeding indoors via the sliding glass door. Continue onward, passing to your right of a television situated along the wall. Enter the kitchen, positioning yourself between the kitchen island and the adjacent pantry.

Exit the restroom and proceed in a counterclockwise direction. Traverse a distance of approximately three strides beyond the white floor covering until you reach the entrance to the adjacent bedroom. Upon entering the bedroom, halt directly in front of the bedside table featuring a circular time-keeping device and a luminescent light source.
Proceed northbound along the crimson pathway for a distance of approximately 10 feet until you reach the fire suppression device.
Ascend via the staircase to the adjacent level. Proceed into the initial chamber situated on your right-hand side and halt immediately beyond the entrance.

Proceed by ascending the staircase to reach the second landing. Upon arrival, execute a 90-degree turn to the right, entering the adjacent room. Position yourself directly upon the rug featuring a doorway situated on your left.

Proceed from the bathroom, traversing the length of the hallway in a northerly direction. Upon reaching the terminus of the corridor, execute a 90-degree turn to the east. Continue onward, passing adjacent to the piano situated against the eastern wall. Ultimately, arrive at a point directly beneath the prominent chandelier suspended above the violin.
Proceed north towards the dwelling structure, then traverse the movable glass panels. Alter your trajectory to the east and terminate at the dining area.

Proceed north from your current location, passing the lavatory on your left. Turn eastward into the adjacent chamber, then proceed to the egress door situated on the eastern wall. Remain stationary near this exit.
Descend the staircase, arriving at the landing whereupon proceed to the terminal door situated on your right-hand side. Upon entering the bathroom, pause momentarily.

Proceed to traverse the room in a generally east-west direction until reaching the opposite extremity of the table. Upon arrival, proceed through the two small wooden doors situated directly ahead. Following egress from the room, execute a 90-degree rotation to the counterclockwise direction and continue moving in a southward trajectory along the linear corridor. Upon approaching the entranceway preceding the oven units, execute a 90-degree rotation to the clockwise direction.
Stand in the entranceway situated between the living space and the large metallic appliance located within the culinary zone.

Exit the bedroom and proceed southward. Continue onward for approximately 10 feet until you reach the kitchen area. Rotate your direction by 90 degrees clockwise to face east. Proceed northward through the kitchen for approximately 15 feet until you arrive at the doorway leading to the adjacent room. Enter the room containing a sink fixture and come to rest within a distance of 2 feet from the sink.

Proceed through the central chamber and veer right into the adjacent compartment containing the lavatory fixture. Continue onward in a direct line until reaching the arched passageway situated on your lefthand side. Make a sharp turn to the left as you approach the entrance of the arched passageway, then proceed through the doorway.
Proceed into the television room. Traverse to the exterior entrance located on the left-hand side of the room. Halt immediately adjacent to the doorway.

Turn 90 degrees counterclockwise and proceed northwards into the bedroom. Continue on this trajectory for a distance of approximately zero meters until you reach a point where you will need to pivot 90 degrees counterclockwise once more. From this new bearing, continue moving eastward for a short duration until you encounter a white rug. Upon reaching this rug, pivot 90 degrees clockwise and proceed southward into the bathroom.
Proceed downwards via the staircase, traversing a total of three levels, culminating at the subterranean terminus.
Turn 180 degrees about your current position and proceed northwards for approximately 10 feet. Then, pivot 90 degrees clockwise and travel eastward across the kitchen area.

Exit the kitchen area and proceed in a northerly direction. Continue along the hallway for a distance of approximately 10 feet until you reach the point where the second doorway on your right aligns directly adjacent to your position.
Proceed northwards along the perimeter of the swimming pool, maintaining a parallel trajectory relative to its longitudinal axis, until you reach the bar situated directly ahead.

Proceed northbound into the kitchen area. Traverse the kitchen space, maintaining a northerly trajectory until you reach the threshold separating the kitchen from the adjacent living room. Upon crossing this boundary, cease your progression and assume a position immediately adjacent to the piece of furniture situated posterior to the sofa.

Turn ninety degrees to the right and vacate the lavatory. Proceed south along the corridor, passing the viniculture storage facility on your left. Continue straight until reaching the subsequent corridor, then maintain a course to the right. Traverse the length of this corridor until arriving at its terminus, whereupon execute a rotational maneuver to orient yourself perpendicular to the staircase. Descend to the first riser.

Exit the sewing room. Proceed northward. Continue onward for approximately 12 feet until reaching the glass display case situated adjacent to a doll exhibit. Alter course to the east, turning ninety degrees to align with the entrance of the adjacent chamber. Traverse the floor space to the west, passing immediately adjacent to a sleeping platform. Enter the subsequent doorway positioned to the south.

Turn 180 degrees to face the opposite direction, then proceed north for approximately 10 feet to reach the entrance of the hallway. Continue east along the hallway for its entirety, measuring 50 feet in length, until reaching the terminus. Upon arrival, execute a 90-degree rotation to the right.
Proceed up the staircase by ascending each step sequentially until you have reached the uppermost level. Remain stationary at this location.

Proceed northwards across the room until you reach the entrance doors. Rotate clockwise by ninety degrees and maintain a lateral position adjacent to the left flank of the smallest chair situated within the seating arrangement.

Proceed by walking in a forward direction for a distance of unknown length. Upon reaching your destination, execute a 90-degree rotation to the counterclockwise direction. Continue moving in this new direction until you encounter three stationary objects positioned on your right-hand side. These objects will be identified as chairs. Once you have passed all three chairs, proceed to a point located adjacent to the fourth object from the set.
Proceed 10 feet beyond the location of the bed and ascend the staircase. Upon reaching the top, halt immediately adjacent to the entrance of the door situated directly ahead.

Proceed by walking laterally away from the swimming pool and proceed in a generally northward direction toward the staircase. Ascend the staircase and execute a 90-degree turn to the east upon reaching the summit. Enter the adjacent chamber containing the massage table. Remain stationary within this area.

Proceed through the entrance of the structure and traverse the corridor in a straight line until reaching the terminal point where the left-hand wall terminates. Enter the compartment adjacent to the final door situated on the lefthand side and position yourself proximal to the appliance units.

Proceed through the entrance comprising two swinging doors, then continue along the pathway defined by the rose-colored carpeting until you reach the subsequent doorframe. Halt immediately prior to crossing into the adjacent area.

Upon arriving at the designated location, proceed to the pink bench and execute a 90-degree rightward rotation. Continue walking in a northerly direction for a distance equivalent to passing four stationary objects positioned on your left-hand side. Upon reaching this point, perform a 180-degree leftward rotation and assume a position adjacent to the entrance of the room.

Turn 180 degrees about your current position and proceed through the doorway. Continue on this trajectory for approximately 90 degrees until you reach the wall adjacent to the door. Then, pivot to face north and traverse the hallway for a distance of approximately 10 feet. Upon reaching the midpoint between two walls, locate a small table situated immediately prior to the entrance of the dining area.

Proceed to ascend to the uppermost point of the stairway, then execute a counterclockwise rotation of 90 degrees. Continue onward, traversing a distance equivalent to the length of the artificial botanical feature located on your right-hand side, until you arrive at the lower extremity of the stairway. Ascend the stairway, culminating at its uppermost point.

Proceed to the kitchen area and navigate to the appliance designated as the stove. From there, proceed to the adjacent room and locate the piece of furniture commonly referred to as the dining room table.

Proceed from your current location in the sitting room, orienting yourself towards the kitchen area. Traverse the floor until you reach the kitchen, then locate the pantry by identifying the first door situated on the left-hand side of your path. Upon entering the pantry, cease movement once you have crossed beyond the architectural feature known as the archway.

Turn 180 degrees to face the door. Proceed north through the kitchen area. Continue straight into the pantry space. Move forward through the hallway. Traverse the length of the hallway until you reach the closet double doors. Pass by the closet double doors to enter the bedroom. Halt your movement when you arrive within the bedroom, positioning yourself immediately prior to the bed.
Proceed northbound through the room, circumventing the staircase located on your left, and arrive at the entrance of the adjacent dining area where you will pause.

Proceed from your current location by walking directly away from your point of origin, exiting the room via the door situated on the right-hand side. Continue onward, traversing the hallway in a generally eastward direction until you reach the entrance to the adjacent room located on the left-hand side. Upon entering said room, execute a clockwise rotation of 90 degrees, thereby orienting yourself in a northerly direction, and come to a halt immediately preceding the mounted taxidermy specimen resembling a mammalian head.

Exit the room in a northerly direction. Proceed south along the hallway for approximately 10 feet until reaching a prominent black bookcase situated on your left. Alter your course by turning east and continue moving south along the hallway for an additional 20 feet until arriving at a bedroom located on your right. Remain stationary at the entrance of the bedroom.

Proceed down the corridor, bypassing the reflective surfaces on either side, and enter the sleeping quarters. Perform a 90-degree rotation to the counterclockwise direction, followed by a second 90-degree rotation to the counterclockwise direction, positioning yourself within the lavatory area. Halt immediately adjacent to the bathing fixture.
Proceed to traverse the distance separating you from the opposing side of the bed, arriving at its edge. Once there, position yourself adjacent to the white bear rug situated on the floor.

Turn left to proceed past the curio cabinet. Proceed northwards towards the kitchen area. Halt when you reach the light switches located on the stone wall immediately preceding the kitchen island featuring a sink.

Proceed through the entrance formed by the pair of double doors. Traverse a linear distance of approximately 10 feet to arrive at a dining area featuring a table centered beneath a suspended lighting fixture composed of multiple glass components. Continue onward for another 15 feet to reach a second set of double doors situated adjacent to a piece of furniture constructed from wood.
Ascend the staircase, then execute a 90-degree rotation to the left, proceeding through the transparent entry doors. Remain stationary at the entrance.

Proceed northwards along the corridor for approximately 10 feet until you reach the rectangular structure commonly referred to as the pool table. From there, turn counterclockwise by 90 degrees to position yourself directly adjacent to the long axis of the pool table. Continue walking in this direction for a distance equivalent to the length of two strides, then halt your progression perpendicular to the linear feature extending upwards from the floor plane, which is commonly known as the stairs.
Proceed from your current location within the bedroom, traverse the floor space in a generally east-west direction until you reach the threshold of the doorway, then come to a complete halt.

Walk past the prominent dining table situated adjacent to the overhead lighting fixture, positioning yourself to pass the table on its right-hand side. Proceed along the crimson-colored pathway leading directly to the initial entranceway encountered following passage of the aforementioned table. Note the presence of several red armchairs positioned immediately adjacent to the forthcoming entranceway. Continue onward into the corridor, halting at the first available entryway situated on your immediate right.

Proceed eastward from your current location for approximately 2 meters, passing the sofa and coffee table on your left. Continue onward for another 3 meters until you reach the pool table. Upon arrival, halt and position yourself adjacent to the window.

Proceed by executing a counterclockwise rotation of 90 degrees relative to your current position, circumventing the wooden barrier until you arrive at the wooden barrier situated diagonally across from your initial location.
Proceed to the entrance adjacent to the prominent mural on your left, then proceed directly south along the corridor until you reach the pair of doorways, where you will come to a halt.

Turn sharply counterclockwise by 90 degrees upon reaching the initial entrance portal. Proceed southward along the corridor for a distance of approximately 10 meters until you arrive at the subsequent entrance portal.
Proceed along the red carpet for a distance of approximately 10 feet until you reach the entrance threshold of the adjacent chamber.

Proceed down the corridor adjacent to the quartet of glass entrance doors. Continue in a northerly direction for approximately 20 feet, then veer sharply to your left and proceed eastward, passing by the kitchen area. Maintain a straight trajectory and continue onward toward the dining room, halting precisely upon reaching the threshold where the flooring transitions from hardwood to carpet.

Turn 180 degrees about face and proceed south along the hallway adjacent to the staircase. Continue straight for approximately 20 feet until you reach the kitchen area. Stop directly beside the pair of double entrance doors.

Proceed by traversing a distance of approximately 0 meters past the table, then execute a 90-degree counterclockwise rotation. Continue walking for a distance of approximately 0 meters past the stove, followed by a 90-degree clockwise rotation. Proceed through the doorway into the adjacent room, then execute a 90-degree counterclockwise rotation. Ascend to a height of 0 meters to the second riser on the staircase.
Turn left. Upon reaching the glass panels, execute a 90-degree turn to the right. Position yourself adjacent to the table bearing the items of a book, a purse, and a hat.

Proceed directly forward. Traverse the horizontal plane until intersecting the linear feature containing seating fixtures. Continue onward until reaching a rectangular structure with stationary seating elements.

Exit the closet by opening the door and stepping out. Proceed northwards for approximately 10 feet until reaching the intersection of the hallway and corridor. At this point, pivot clockwise through 90 degrees to align yourself with the double doors. Continue moving forward for another 15 feet until arriving at the double doors. Position yourself adjacent to the sink.

Turn left upon exiting the room and proceed down the corridor towards the exit. Continue straight ahead through the doorway. Ascend the staircase comprising two flights, positioning yourself for ascent by aligning your trajectory with the stairwell. Upon reaching the top, navigate towards the bathroom situated adjacent to seating accommodations located on the left-hand side.

Proceed by ascending the staircase, traverse the area situated between the dining table and seating arrangement, continue onward into the adjacent rooms via doorways, navigate through the primary living space, proceed upwards along the stairway until reaching the first step.

Turn left and proceed into the room situated on the left-hand side of your current position. Continue straight ahead for approximately 10 feet until you arrive at a wall perpendicular to your path. Then, turn left and enter the adjacent room located directly to your left.
